acceptanceCriteria: the test waits for the shim's pid record (or a readiness signal) before starting the operation timeout, so load cannot fire the timeout first; reproduced at BASE under load and passing after, with loads retained
the interop package's runtime under load is measured; if it still exceeds the hang detector, its slowest tests are named in V1-0849
body: Residual from the V1-1290 lane (PR #955, 2026-10-16). interop/cem01-go TestStableLifecycleOpTimeoutRetiresDescendants fails with 'descendant pid not recorded' on the lane head and on a git archive of base f81114713 at load ~60: its 500 ms operation timeout fires before the shim writes its pid. The full interop package then hit the 30-minute hang detector during TestCEMV1094PortableProducerOnlyEmptyAccept, which passes alone in 53 s. Related: V1-1387 (process-group cleanup), V1-0849 umbrella.
title: tests (suspected): interop TestStableLifecycleOpTimeoutRetiresDescendants fails under load ('descendant pid not recorded'); full interop/cem01-go exceeds 30 m at load ~60
